Class AbstractPutBuilder<T, S extends AbstractPutBuilder<T,S>>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractPutBuilder<T,S>
Type Parameters:
T - the item type
S - the concrete builder type (for fluent chaining)
Direct Known Subclasses:
AsyncPutBuilder, PutBuilder
public abstract class AbstractPutBuilder<T, S extends AbstractPutBuilder<T,S>> extends Object
Abstract base for sync and async put-item builders.

    • condition

      public @NonNull S condition(@NonNull Consumer<ConditionExpression.Builder> configurator)
      Configures a condition expression that gates the put operation. DynamoDB evaluates this condition before writing the item (unlike a filter expression which applies after reading).
      Parameters:
      configurator - a consumer to build the condition expression
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • returnValues

      public @NonNull S returnValues(@Nullable software.amazon.awssdk.services.dynamodb.model.ReturnValue returnValues)
      Configures which item attributes to return after the put.

      When set, uses the low-level PutItemRequest with the specified ReturnValues. Common values: ReturnValue.ALL_OLD (returns the previous item if one existed), ReturnValue.NONE.

      To retrieve the previous item when using ReturnValue#ALL_OLD, use executeReturning() instead of execute().

      Parameters:
      returnValues - the return value setting, or null to use the default
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • withOptimisticLocking

      public @NonNull S withOptimisticLocking()
      Enables optimistic locking for this put operation.

      When enabled, the library adds a condition expression checking that the version attribute hasn't changed, and increments the version on success.

      Returns:
      this builder for chaining
